walkthroughs.title: Get started with GTIN Code Atlas
walkthroughs.description: Open a sample code list, check its element strings, decode them and verify check digits, and try the Pro Digital Link conversion and serial inventory in the free 14-day trial.

steps.title: Open a sample file
steps.description:
GTIN Code Atlas reads one code per line: GS1 element strings in brackets such as (01)09506000134352(17)271231, raw scanner data with group separators, GS1 Digital Links, and bare GTIN or SSCC numbers. The sample is an invented warehouse list with one wrong check digit and a duplicate serial, so every report has something to show.
[Open Sample File](command:gtinCodeAtlas.openSample)

steps.title: Run Show Element String Check
steps.description:
Every element string checked against the GS1 identifier table: form, number of elements and the first problem found. The report opens as a new Markdown document; your file is not changed.
[Show Element String Check](command:gtinCodeAtlas.showValidation)

steps.title: Use the other free reports
steps.description:
Every free report works without a key, an account or a network connection: Show Decoded Elements, Show Check Digits.
[Show Decoded Elements](command:gtinCodeAtlas.showDecoded)
[Show Check Digits](command:gtinCodeAtlas.showCheckDigits)

steps.title: Try Pro free for 14 days
steps.description:
The first Pro command you run starts a free 14-day trial on this computer, with no key and no network: Show Digital Link Conversion, Show GTIN And Serial Inventory.
[Show Digital Link Conversion](command:gtinCodeAtlas.showDigitalLink)

steps.title: Licence and help
steps.description:
Buy Pro (Personal USD 19, Business USD 39 per user), enter a key, see the licence status, or report a problem.
[Show Licence Status](command:gtinCodeAtlas.licenceStatus)
[Report A Problem](command:gtinCodeAtlas.reportProblem)

gtinCodeAtlas.maxFileSizeMB.markdownDescription: Largest file (in MB) a report reads, up to 50 MB (VS Code passes files only up to 50 MB to extensions). Larger files are refused with a message.

gtinCodeAtlas.openReportsAsPreview.markdownDescription: Open each report in the Markdown preview as well as in a new editor.
